subject: Data-address-identifier
notes: ADDRESS OF W, with W BASED, used as the receiving operand of SET ... UP BY (SR23 data-pointer category fits) and of INITIALIZE (SR1 and SR7). Only SR5 forbids these. INITIALIZE (and every non-SET receiving position) is refused by SR5 itself, COBOL3979, from the receiving chokepoint's form table (kb/Work PB1551, w1097d; it was COBOL0901); SET ... UP BY is still a parse error (COBOL0001) because SET's receiving identifier carries no data-address alternative. Controls on a pointer item P compile.
